summary: Cancel a Node Timeout by handle or compatible primitive and return undefined.

target.notes: Cancel matching Timeout state without invoking its callback; return JavaScript undefined.

semantics.cancellation: prevents future callback if still pending
semantics.accepted_handle: Timeout from setTimeout or setInterval; same-thread primitive token is also accepted
semantics.cross_api: can cancel an interval Timeout handle

caveats: Do not assume the handle is a plain integer; Node returns a Timeout object.
Unknown numeric/string ids are effectively non-matching rather than arbitrary OS timer ids.

tests.name: also cancels interval handle
tests.input: let n=0; const i=setInterval(()=>n++,1); clearTimeout(i); setTimeout(()=>console.log(n),5);
